interpretation: Under an intact authoritative V17 terminal-receipt source, retry/restart/cache corruption need not mutate a separate RewardConsumption ledger to obtain exactly-once material reward projection: rebuilding from the canonical unique DONE set is sufficient for the tested failure classes.

The raw RewardPlasticityCandidate remains a negative control: duplicate admitted evidence changes its state twice, so exactly-once is supplied by the source-set projection boundary rather than the inner update rule.

A derived cache may be added later only if its source-universe digest, reward-policy identity and projected state identity are independently verifiable and the cache is always discardable/rebuildable.

This does not solve rollback/replacement of the authoritative source lineage itself; when a DONE receipt is removed from disposable source truth, the projection correctly rolls back with it. That dependency belongs to UnifiedDB/recovery selected-lineage authority.
